svg.aria-label: Tech stack. Mobile Android: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Room, Koin, Firebase, Material 3. Frontend web: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Astro, Next.js. Backend e IA: Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Express, SQLite, RAG local. Workflow: Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Vercel, GitHub Pages.
